name: ai-brief-processor
description: Processamento assíncrono de briefings com análise estruturada por LLM.

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run start:dev --workspace backend
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run start:dev --workspace worker
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace worker && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace shared && npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace worker && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace backend -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace worker
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test:e2e --workspace backend
scripts.docker:up: npm run env:setup && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose logs -f frontend backend worker mongodb redis
